st.title: Pet Travel Stories – What Owners Say
st.intro: These are short summaries, written by us, of public forum discussions in which dog and cat owners talk about flying or moving abroad with their pets. Each card keeps a short quote in the original language and links to the original discussion. They are owners' experiences, not airline rules: always check with the airline and the official sources before you travel. We don't show usernames.
f.intro.p: A place for pet owners to share first-hand experiences of travelling with a dog or cat, so others can prepare before their own trip. Every post and comment is checked by a moderator before it appears. Experiences are organised by:
f.intro.transport: Transport: flights in the cabin or the hold, trains, buses, subways, taxis, cars and ferries.
f.intro.weather: Weather and season: hot or cold days, rain or snow, and how the temperature affected the trip.
f.intro.carrier: Carrier: soft bag, hard crate, stroller or harness only, including what fitted under the seat and what staff checked.
f.intro.breed: Pet, breed and size: dog or cat, the breed the owner shared, and a weight band.
f.intro.stories: summaries of public discussions about flying and moving abroad with dogs and cats, with short quotes and links to the original threads.
f.intro.rules: what you can post and how moderation works.
f.intro.airlines: official cabin and hold rules for each airline we cover, checked against the airline's own page and dated.
